name: Hahako Shussan Shokushu
source:
A royal soldieress searches for her captured daughter. 
She endures humiliations from dastardly men, determined to save her. 
Her daughter is violated so deeply she spews birth tentacles from her womb. 
In thd end both girls surrender to the eggs and labour.
